versions.changelog:
- Initial release of apex-alpha-score signal.
- Provides a proprietary real-time alpha score indicating current market opportunity quality.
- Integrates with the APEX Runner live autonomous trading system (Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, and Hyperliquid).
- Supports x402 protocol for seamless authenticated, pay-per-use API access via EVM wallet—no traditional API key needed.
- Tiered early adopter and loyalty discounts built in; $5/call standard price.
- Includes example usage, sample response, and links to related signals.
